name: Issue 3563: Wind Surge's chain-target modifier on Weapon Engraving: Air is wired and native
contract: 805750 is a native SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER aura on SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS (misc=17), EffectBasePoints=2,
EffectDieSides=1 - SpellInfo::CalcValue's DieSides==1 branch (SpellInfo.cpp:498-500) always adds +1 to a
single-sided roll, so the real computed jump-target bonus is 3, not the raw BasePoints field - family 38
classmask1=0x40000, matching the SpellFamilyFlags of Weapon Engraving: Air's own damage/trigger spell 653226
(classmask0=0x20000/classmask1=0x40000, no SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS). 653257 carries the exact
same classmask but its own AttributesEx3 sets SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS
(SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod, SpellInfo.cpp:1494-1496 - 'dont check duration mod' branch still applies,
but every other spellmod op including SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS is unconditionally skipped for such a spell);
this is a deliberate exemption on 653257 itself, not a Wind Surge bug, and matches EffectTriggerSpell[0] on
653225 pointing only at 653226 as the spell actually cast on proc - 653257 is never the live damage path.
Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets (Spell.cpp:1888-1892) reads maxTargets=Effects[effIndex].ChainTarget (0
for both spells) and unconditionally calls ApplySpellMod(id, SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS, maxTargets, this)
before checking maxTargets>1, so Wind Surge's own mechanism is fully native and wired: this is proven below
with the spell_modifier query, independent of whether Weapon Engraving: Air ever actually casts.
OBSERVATION (out of this issue's scope, not asserted here): Weapon Engraving: Air's own proc aura 653225
('Air Engraving', EffectApplyAuraName[0]=354, EffectTriggerSpell[0]=653226) is one of the unported Ascension
auras 317-366 documented in src/server/game/Spells/Auras/SpellAuraDefines.h ('have no immediate core effect
until their individual mechanics are ported'). AuraEffect::HandleProc's switch
(SpellAuraEffects.cpp:1396-1413) only calls HandleProcTriggerSpellAuraProc for
SPELL_AURA_DUMMY/SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL(42); aura 354 falls to the default no-op, so 653226 is never
cast off a real hit today. This is a pre-existing gap in Weapon Engraving: Air itself, not in Wind Surge.

steps.label: SETUP: no chain-target bonus on Weapon Engraving: Air before learning Wind Surge
CONTRACT: Wind Surge's SpellMod adds 3 chain targets to 653226 (2 base + 1 die-roll)
SETUP: 653257 shares the classmask but is exempt via SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS
